title: TomasuLLM：面向LLM智能体的乱序推测执行运行时
summary: TomasuLLM是一个智能体运行时，通过乱序推测执行工具调用，在隔离的写时复制沙箱中预运行未来动作并追踪依赖，验证后按轨迹顺序提交结果。在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和SWE-Marathon上分别实现1.31x、1.35x和1.27x加速，且4010条审计记录中零误接受。
summary_en: TomasuLLM is an agent runtime that executes tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces dependencies, and commits results in trajectory order after validation. It achieves 1.31x on SWE-bench Verified, 1.35x on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 1.27x on SWE-Marathon, with zero false accepts across 4,010 audited records.
